description: For a company whose people work from several cities: what they can book INSTANTLY on a One Coworking team account in each named city — spaces with an instantly bookable day pass, their median day-pass price (net EUR, what the team pays in credits) and how many also have bookable meeting rooms. Same numbers as https://www.onecoworking.com/solutions/teams. Use it before recommending a team account; the answer also carries the account terms (1 credit = €1 net, €500 first top-up, credits valid 6 months, no per-seat fee) and the link to the free coverage check for cities not covered yet.
